_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for SurveyPesa (surveypesa.co.ke) pricing.
Consumed by surveypesa-backend/server.js for request validation, and
checked against the real HTML pages by _test-pricing-sync.mjs so the
tier price can never silently drift again.
This file is for the SurveyPesa product ONLY. The Hela Sasa product has
its own pricing in ../stk-push-server/server.js (ALLOWED_TIERS) and is
deliberately NOT kept in sync - they are separate sites on a shared
HashBack account, distinguishable by the SP- / HS- reference prefixes.

legacyPages.note: legacy page realigned to the Lite tier (was KSh 49)
